result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Company may assign without consent to affiliates and transaction successors; Contractor assignments remain subject to Company's consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, with an absolute competitor prohibition; and Company change of control creates no Contractor termination right. Unrelated commercial intent is preserved. It is not strictly minimal because it also adds reorganizations, a notice condition, and prohibitions on suspension and repricing beyond the stated playbook requirements, though these additions are commercially related and professionally drafted.
